parent.different_source_lineage: DK13/R17 extend motion-family MG11 PR1094, NOT novelty-family MG13 PR1103

protocol.frozen_definition: At EVERY live decision, reload original independently source-verified post-FIT checkpoint into same original source actor, start fresh empty episode memory, choose ONLY from current true source-public image/direction/mission, apply actual original selected env.step(action) in separate environment, NEVER feed consequence to that actor. The evaluator still records its public consequence, no teacher or hidden state. Go actor must re-read identical baseline FIT checkpoint and report exactly 1664 samples with 0 live updates; Ygg source restore 1664 samples; conventional restore 1664 and empty episode. Cannot claim it is a pure memory ablation because it disables BOTH online selected update and episode memory and pays different restart overhead; it is a bundled freeze ablation.
protocol.online_definition: Call byte-for-byte original MG14 evaluator source code/unchanged Go DK13/Ygg R17/classical selected feedback to choose and update once on every own actual original selected event. No changes to native score, reward, public input or environmental physics.
protocol.random_definition: Original MG14 independent uniform random; source env.step per chosen action; random seed evaluator-only.

primary.criterion: For each original actor family compare actual true positive goals and source-success metric for online vs frozen; separately measure real door-open counts, held+door-front frames, forward while key held, selected-action counts and action diversity. Report if online moves away from trained frozen behavior, but DO NOT equate different trajectories with useful learned generalization. Only bounded positive if BOTH Go DK13 and Ygg R17 online complete >=1 authentic original goal AND each outperform its own frozen arm by >=1 true goal over same three seeds; strong conventional must also be reported. Otherwise negative NO_SCIENCE. Does not prove isolated causal effect of online learning because frozen resets episode memory together.

measurements: all real source-selected public before/action/after/reward, term and trunc
for each arm source-selected action distribution and true goal rewards
door opening transitions validated by original public source adapter
per-episode observed distinct public views and actions
online vs cold-frozen F16/Go original source checkpoint samples and child CPU/host CPU/RSS
matched original starting public observations per seed
two complete independent original source process canonical digests
authority: All draft/unmerged. No acceptance or promotion of native models, FORGE/CKB controllers, G29/Atlas first use or held-out transfer. Three new seeds are development only. No changed original Wingless R8, Ygg R10-R12, Go DK13 or Ygg R17 original source.
